decision_rule.statement: Block the change when any case fails all 3 of its trials, or when the share of cases passing every trial falls below the lower bound of the Wilson 95% interval of the previous results for the same scope.

source.description: The Gate 1 check once accepted a criterion whose "more than" had been flipped to "less than" as word for word.

cases.expected: The three criteria are copied word for word, with their comparisons ("more than", "or less") and amounts unchanged.

source.description: The Gate 1 check once accepted a criterion cut short before its condition ("only when the item total is at least $20.00 and the coupon has not expired").

cases.expected: Both criteria are copied whole, the discount condition included, and the story is held to the full track (a coupon is pricing, a Red domain).

source.description: The Gate 1 check once accepted an "Out of scope" line promoted to an acceptance criterion.

cases.expected: Only the two in-scope criteria are recorded; the out-of-scope price order is not a criterion.

source.description: The Gate 1 check once accepted a Jira comment promoted to an acceptance criterion.

cases.expected: The one criterion is recorded; the HTML comment and the product owner's comment are context, not criteria.

source.description: The Red-domain floor once missed every Spanish term, so a payment story written in Spanish could run below the full track.

cases.expected: Both criteria are copied word for word in Spanish, and the story is held to the full track because it takes a payment.

source.description: Bench Shop --bug stale-badge: the cart badge does not count down on a remove until a reload (STORY-003, RISK-001).

cases.expected: An automated case covers the badge counting down right after a remove, without a reload, so a test can catch the stale badge.

checks.pattern: updates to N-1 without a page reload

source.description: Bench Shop --bug wrong-item-total and --bug inconsistent-total: the overview item total is off by $1.00, or the total is not item total plus tax (STORY-020, RISK-001 and RISK-002).

cases.expected: Automated cases cover both the item total being the sum of the line prices and the total being the item total plus tax.

checks.pattern: equals the exact sum of the unit prices

source.description: A price check written as a click on text=Item total: $39.98 fails with Bench Shop --bug wrong-item-total; changing the price to $40.98 makes it pass and hides a pricing bug.

cases.expected: The Healer declines: the app shows the wrong item total, which is a product bug for a bug draft, not a locator to repair.

source.description: A wait for the badge to read 1 after a remove fails with Bench Shop --bug stale-badge; waiting for 2, or for any badge, makes it pass and hides the stale badge.

cases.expected: The Healer declines: the badge did not count down, which is the product bug the test exists to catch.

source.description: Control for the false-heal cases: a test-id renamed by Bench Shop v2 (add-to-cart-<id> to add-<id>) is a genuine locator break, so a Healer that declines everything does not pass the set.

cases.expected: The Healer repairs the add-to-cart locator to the v2 test id with a change the guardrails accept, and leaves the badge assertion as it is.
